scope: Exact procedure delta only: one new connection attempt to already installed SF after a new actual USB replug and expected COM inventory. This is conditional procedure admission, not successful connection or physical throughput acceptance.

personally_checked.method: Read-only saved JSON/log review, six helper source diffs, SHA-256 and byte comparisons using local Python; no helper execution, product test, COM, SWD, Reset or Flash.
personally_checked.helper_diff: Analyzer/decoder identical; register decoder help path only; both SWD reader bases moved to board-02 without gate changes; runner binds this verdict, parent zero-wire failure/readback/reset, expected COM/PNP and a new replug record. Separate output directory rejects reuse.
personally_checked.parent_result: FAIL TransportOpenError; cleanup_finished=true, phase=closed, host_bytes=0, device_bytes=0, chunks=0, received=0, R=null. No START was sent.
personally_checked.parent_reset_log: Expected probe serial 57005400120000393333574E, MCU Reset and Application started; parent readback is byte-equal to exact SF.

mandatory_execution_conditions: A new actual user reply to the pending ten-second USB replug request must arrive. Do not reuse the earlier reply. Bind the new record to the saved parent reset-log SHA and record actual chronology.
After that reply, obtain fresh COM6 inventory with exact expected PNP ID and verify no competing serial/application owner. Boot register values alone do not prove USB enumeration.
First session: program=0, Reset=0, one connection attempt and at most one START at 150000 samples/s, mode5, requested Record30s. Use the fresh board-02 output directory and exact pinned inputs.
Preserve the original connectivity FAIL. Any new failure stops this plan without automatic retry or rollback; retain SF unless a separately assessed concrete recovery need arises.
Only after every first-session gate passes may 50000/100000 profiles run for5s each, with their own successful Reset/Run and actual new user replug before each START.
No SWD/halt while the serial owner is active. Retain the existing closed-owner, END/ACK, offline raw/CRC/Open, fresh diagnostic identity, deadline and stopped-register gates.

C1.reason: Continuation does not erase the first failure or consume a second START; same installed image, new exact output scope and unchanged physical criteria.

C2.reason: One-open limit, parent closure/zero-wire checks, fresh reply/COM gates and stop-on-failure are explicit; chronology and absence of another owner still require the operator.

C3.reason: New and parent saved evidence was inspected and hash-linked; future enumeration and acquisition are explicitly not claimed.

C4.reason: New board-02 base consistently separates attempts; generic inherited session rules are qualified by the explicit first-session no-reset exception.

C5.reason: Exact plan, helper pins, parent evidence and separate output paths support reproducible handoff.

limitations: PASS admits only the stated procedure once its mandatory conditions are met; pending replug is not presumed satisfied.
Source, ARM, native model and retained Windows package acceptance were not repeated or extended.
No new conclusion about USB root cause, physical sample rate, sustained150k, ADC accuracy or an ignition input.
